Convert liters to gallons: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. Let's convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. We'll call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36 (rounded).
